endangerment.comment: Lisu (lis-lis) = 3 (Wider communication). Language of recognized nationality: Lisu. Language of wider communication at the end of the 19th century and the early 1900s when Lisu people left China to emigrate to Myanmar, Thailand and India. Used in education, trade, communication, and music.
